name: joint-bob-promo-video
description: Landing page films for Joint Bob, built from real screen recordings of throwaway nodes.

scripts.capture: cd .. && for take in handoff webhook costs move cluster schedule browser secrets; do node --import tsx promo-video/capture/record.ts --take $take || exit 1; done
scripts.render:all: cd .. && for film in teaser hero lid team schedule alerts browser secrets analytics; do node --import tsx promo-video/render.ts --film $film || exit 1; done
